sample_unit: patient-generated questions answered by ChatGPT-4 and rheumatologists

links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT-4 answers versus specialist answers to patient psoriatic arthritis questions
links.effect: ChatGPT responses were on average more readable than clinician responses across readability indices; patients preferred ChatGPT answers 491/998 times (49.2%) versus 343/998 (34.4%) for clinicians.
links.quote: ChatGPT responses were, on average, more readable across indices.

screen.reason: The study directly evaluates ChatGPT-4 answers to patient questions compared to rheumatologists, rated by both clinicians and patients, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
